snippet.title: Indigo's Dreams - Official PC Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Buy on Kickstarter now!
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/indigosdreams/indigos-dreams

Wishlist on Steam here!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3553630/Indigos_Dreams/

A mixed-media video game of a Wonderland. Indigo's Dreams combines visual style including claymation, puppetry, and pixel-art to make for a unique handmade experience. Play as Indigo, a young girl trying to find her way back home after her dreams take her to a land unknown.

Traverse through abandoned beaches, hidden forests, a cloud town, and more. Discover newfound purpose along your way. Collect costumes, fight strange, mutated bosses, and meet tons of wacky characters as you progress through the game.

#gaming #indiegaming
